data.title: US State Dept. introduces sanctions targeting Iran in Operation Economic Outcast | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Sanctions targeted Iranian individuals and companies that facilitated the trade of petroleum and petrochemical products with Iran or supported military action against US forces.
